title: Scientific Assessments and Cooperation for Climate Change
abstract: Many global challenges characterizing the anthropocene, from climate change to food security and biodiversity loss, are wicked problems, characterized by complexity, nonlinearity, barriers to cooperation, and the lack of a clearly defined solution. In order to solve these challenges, the solutions require cooperation across scales. In this context, scientists assemble into institutions of varying structural complexity to produce scientific information, which policymakers consider to make decisions. In particular, institutions at the science-policy interface, including global environmental assessments, which are formal efforts to assemble knowledge to support decision making, play an important role. This study aims at understanding the role of scientific assessments in enabling cooperation for global environmental challenges, focusing on the Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change (IPCC). To do so, we use a game theoretical approach to consider the role of aggregating scientific knowledge through assessments in cooperation for climate change. Results demonstrate that sharing information, reaching scientific consensus, and reducing uncertainty through assessments expands the conditions for cooperation.
abstract_zh: 人类世所面临的许多全球性挑战，从气候变化到粮食安全和生物多样性丧失，都是棘手问题，其特点是复杂性、非线性、合作障碍，以及缺乏明确界定的解决方案。为了解决这些挑战，解决方案需要跨尺度的合作。在此背景下，科学家们汇聚于结构复杂程度各异的机构之中，以生产科学信息，供政策制定者在作出决策时加以考虑。特别是，处于科学与政策交界处的机构——包括全球环境评估（即为支持决策而汇集知识的正式努力）——发挥着重要作用。本研究旨在理解科学评估在促进全球环境挑战合作中所发挥的作用，并以政府间气候变化专门委员会（IPCC）为例。为此，我们采用博弈论方法，考察通过评估汇集科学知识对气候变化合作的作用。结果表明，分享信息、达成科学共识以及通过评估减少不确定性，能够扩大合作的条件。

title: Reviving Vavilov's Vision: The Tragedy of Biodiversity Governance and Principles for Reform
venue: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences
abstract: This perspective addresses two of humanity’s greatest challenges: feeding a growing population and conserving biodiversity. We begin by examining the legacy of Nikolai Vavilov, who pioneered the improvement of crops such as wheat and beans by hybridizing them with their wild relatives. This strategy used wild species biodiversity to introduce new genetic variation into crops, making them more resilient and productive. Its adoption around the world greatly increased food security and brought lasting benefits to humanity. However, since the 1990 s, well-intentioned laws shifted the governance of biodiversity from a shared global resource to the sovereign control of nation states, with serious unintended consequences. These changes have disrupted the collection, preservation, exchange, and use of biodiversity, all of which are central to Vavilov’s strategy for crop improvement and to biodiversity science more broadly. Efforts at reform have been frustrated as the issues became moralized, inhibiting the open dialogue needed for change. Using foundational concepts shared by science and good governance, we propose seven empirically grounded principles for reform, to help realign biodiversity governance with its intended aims. We then illustrate one possible framework—underpinned by global financing to protect biodiversity hotspots—that would align incentives and work in synergy with the principles to foster practical reform. The principles, together with frameworks that align incentives, would create the conditions for stronger biodiversity conservation and research, agricultural development, global food security, and all the associated benefits to humanity.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨人类面临的两大挑战：养活不断增长的人口与保护生物多样性。我们首先考察尼古拉·瓦维洛夫（Nikolai Vavilov）的学术遗产。他率先通过将小麦、豆类等作物与其野生近缘种杂交来改良作物。这一策略利用野生物种的生物多样性为作物引入新的遗传变异，使其更具抗逆性和生产力。该策略在世界范围内的推广极大地提高了粮食安全，并为人类带来了持久的益处。然而，自20世纪90年代以来，出于良好初衷的法律将生物多样性治理从全球共享资源转变为各国主权控制，由此产生了严重的非预期后果。这些变化扰乱了生物多样性的收集、保存、交换与利用，而这些环节恰恰是瓦维洛夫作物改良策略的核心，也是更广义的生物多样性科学的基础。由于相关议题逐渐被道德化，改革努力屡屡受挫，阻碍了变革所需的开放式讨论。基于科学与良好治理所共有的基础性概念，我们提出七项经验依据充分的改革原则，以帮助生物多样性治理重新回归其设定的目标。随后，我们阐释一种可能的框架，该框架以全球融资保护生物多样性热点地区为基础，能够协调激励机制，并与上述原则形成协同，从而推动切实可行的改革。这些原则与协调激励的框架相结合，将为加强生物多样性保护与研究、农业发展、全球粮食安全，以及由此带来的一切人类福祉创造条件。

title: A Cautious Approach to Subsidies for Environmental Sustainability
A Technology-Centred Approach to Climate Change Negotiations
Property Rights to the World's (Linear) Ocean Fisheries in Customary International Law
venue: Journal of the Association of Environmental and Resource Economists
abstract: I model the ocean as an array of lines set within a two-dimensional frame, and show how the Exclusive Economic Zone emerged as an equilibrium in customary international law. I find that custom codifies the efficient Nash equilibrium of enclosure for nearshore fisheries. For highly migratory and offshore fisheries, enclosure is inefficient, and customary law supports a more efficient “free sea” regime. The model also identifies the trigger for changes in property rights and the reason choice of a particular limit, like the current 200-mile zone, is arbitrary. In an asymmetric, regional sea, I find that the scope of the EEZ is determined by the relative power of coastal and distant water states, and need not be efficient. Finally, I find that proposals to nationalize the seas or ban fishing on the high seas are neither efficient nor supportable as equilibria in customary law.
abstract_zh: 我将海洋建模为二维框架中的一组线段，并说明专属经济区如何在习惯国际法中作为一种均衡而形成。我发现，习惯法将近岸渔业中圈占的有效纳什均衡予以固化。对于高度洄游性和远洋渔业而言，圈占是低效的，习惯法支持一种更为有效的“公海自由”制度。该模型还识别出产权变化的触发因素，以及特定界限（如当前的200海里区）选择具有任意性的原因。在一个不对称的区域性海域中，我发现专属经济区的范围取决于沿海国与远洋渔业国的相对实力，且未必是有效的。最后，我发现主张将海洋国有化或禁止公海捕鱼的提议，既不是有效的，也不能作为习惯法中的均衡而成立。

title: The Global Commons of Ocean Fisheries
Population, Ecological Footprint and the Sustainable Development Goals
abstract: The Anthropocene can be read as being the era when the demand humanity makes on the biosphere’s goods and services—humanity’s ‘ecological footprint’—vastly exceeds its ability to supply it on a sustainable basis. Because the ‘ecological’ gap is met by a diminution of the biosphere, the inequality is increasing. We deploy estimates of the ecological gap, global GDP and its growth rates in recent years, and the rate at which natural capital has declined, to study three questions: (1) at what rate must efficiency at which Nature’s services are converted into GDP rise if the UN’s Sustainable Development Goals for year 2030 are to be sustainable; (2) what would a sustainable figure for world population be if global living standard is to be maintained at an acceptably high level? (3) What living standard could we aspire to if world population was to attain the UN’s near lower-end projection for 2100 of 9 billion? While we take a global perspective, the reasoning we deploy may also be applied on a smaller scale. The base year we adopt for our computations is the pre-pandemic 2019.
abstract_zh: 人类世可以理解为这样一个时代：人类对生物圈商品与服务的需求——即人类的“生态足迹”——大大超过了其在可持续基础上的供给能力。由于这一“生态”缺口是通过削减生物圈来弥补的，不平等程度也在不断加剧。我们运用生态缺口的估计值、近年来全球GDP及其增长率，以及自然资本的下降速度，研究三个问题：（1）若要使联合国2030年可持续发展目标具有可持续性，自然服务转化为GDP的效率须以何种速度提升；（2）若要维持可接受的较高全球生活水平，世界人口的可持续规模应为多少；（3）若世界人口达到联合国对2100年所作的接近下限的预测值90亿，我们可以期望达到何种生活水平。尽管我们采取全球视角，所运用的推理同样可以应用于较小的尺度。我们计算所采用的基准年为疫情爆发前的2019年。

title: Dikes versus Windmills: Climate Treaties and Adaptation
abstract: This paper begins with a tribute to William Nordhaus, focusing on the two questions that have motivated his life’s work. The first is by how much carbon dioxide emissions should be reduced over time. The second is how to reach and enforce an agreement among sovereign nations to limit carbon dioxide emissions. Nordhaus was awarded the Nobel Prize for his efforts to answer the first question. I argue here that the answer to this question has been solved to a satisfactory extent, not only by economists, but by diplomats, and that the greatest need now is to answer the second question. I also present a simple model that extends previous research into this second question, a model in which countries choose both whether to abate and whether to adapt. Like all previous research on this topic, including Nordhaus’s own, the model doesn’t provide a neat solution, only another perspective on one of the most vexing questions in all of human history: how to prevent a tragedy of the commons of global proportions and with profound and possibly catastrophic consequences.
abstract_zh: 本文首先向威廉·诺德豪斯致敬，聚焦于推动其毕生研究的两个问题。第一个问题是二氧化碳排放应随时间减少多少。第二个问题是如何促使主权国家达成协议并执行，以限制二氧化碳排放。诺德豪斯因其对第一个问题的研究而获得诺贝尔奖。我认为，这一问题的答案已不仅由经济学家，也由外交官在相当程度上给出了令人满意的解答，当前最迫切的需求是回答第二个问题。我还提出了一个简单模型，以扩展此前对第二个问题的研究：在该模型中，各国同时选择是否减排以及是否适应。与此前关于这一主题的所有研究（包括诺德豪斯本人的研究）一样，该模型并未提供一个简洁的解决方案，而只是为人类历史上最棘手的问题之一提供了另一种视角：如何防止具有全球规模、且可能带来深远甚至灾难性后果的公地悲剧。

title: Enforcing Access Restrictions to Fishery Zones
Choices in the Climate Commons
abstract:
Climate change is a tragedy of the commons of existential importance. At the annual United Nations climate summit that concludes this week, parties will affirm the necessity to avoid dangerous climate change. But between now and next year's summit, these same countries will in many ways act so as to hasten the outcome that they say must be avoided. This disjunction between what countries say and what they do has been repeated every year since the first summit in 1995. It is a pattern of behavior that seems irrational, but that can be explained. American ecologist Garrett Hardin's classic article, “The Tragedy of the Commons,” published in
Science
50 years ago this week, vividly describes the dilemma that causes this behavior (see page 1236).
abstract_zh: 气候变化是一场关乎生存的公地悲剧。在本周结束的年度联合国气候峰会上，各缔约方将重申必须避免危险的气候变化。但在今天与明年的峰会之间，这些同样的国家在许多方面的行为，实际上却在加速它们自己所说必须避免的结果。自1995年首次峰会以来，各国言行之间的这种脱节每年都在重演。这种行为模式看似不理性，但其实可以得到解释。美国生态学家加勒特·哈丁在50年前的本周，于《科学》（Science）上发表了其经典文章《公地悲剧》（“The Tragedy of the Commons”），生动地描述了导致这一行为的困境（见第1236页）。

title: An Experimental Investigation into 'Pledge and Review' in Climate Negotiations
Collective Action to Avoid Catastrophe: When Countries Succeed, When they Fail, and Why
Coordination vs. Voluntarism and Enforcement in Sustaining International Environmental Cooperation
venue: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences
abstract: The fates of “transboundary” environmental systems depend on how nation states interact with one another. In the absence of a hegemon willing and able to coerce other states into avoiding a “tragedy of the commons,” shared environments will be safeguarded if international cooperation succeeds and degraded or even destroyed if it fails. Treaties and related institutions of international law give form to these efforts to cooperate. Often, they implore states to act in their collective (as opposed to their national) interests. Sometimes, they impel cooperating states to punish free riders. A few agreements coordinate states’ behavior. Here, I present simple game-theoretic models showing whether and how treaties and related institutions can change incentives, aligning states’ self-interests with their collective interests. I show that, as a general matter, states struggle to cooperate voluntarily and enforce agreements to cooperate but that they find it relatively easy to coordinate actions. In some cases, the need for coordination is manifest. In other cases, it requires strategic thinking. Coordination may fall short of supporting an ideal outcome, but it nearly always works better than the alternatives.
abstract_zh: “跨界”环境系统的命运取决于各国之间如何互动。在缺乏有意愿且有能力迫使其他国家避免“公地悲剧”的霸权国家的情况下，如果国际合作成功，共享环境将得到保护；如果合作失败，共享环境则会退化甚至被毁坏。国际法的条约及相关机制赋予这些合作努力以具体形式。它们常常敦促各国以集体（而非国家）利益为行动准则。有时，它们还促使合作国家惩罚搭便车者。少数协定则协调各国的行为。在此，我提出简单的博弈论模型，以说明条约及相关机制能否以及如何改变激励，使各国的自身利益与集体利益相一致。我表明，总体而言，各国难以自愿合作并执行合作协议，但它们相对容易就行动进行协调。在某些情形下，协调的必要性是显而易见的；在另一些情形下，则需要战略性思考。协调未必能支撑理想结果，但它几乎总是比其他替代方案效果更好。

title: Climate Engineering Reconsidered
Environment and Development Economics: Essays in Honor of Sir Partha Dasgupta (edited volume)
Negotiating to Avoid 'Dangerous' Climate Change
venue: Development of Policy Regimes to Combat Climate Change
abstract: Ever since the Framework Convention on Climate Change was adopted in 1992, negotiation of emission limits has been intertwined with efforts to define a threshold for “dangerous” climate change. In this chapter, I explain the logic behind this framing of the collective action problem; show why this framing has failed to limit emissions so as to avoid “dangerous” climate change; and, finally, propose an alternative framing that can be expected to achieve more collective action.
abstract_zh: 自1992年《联合国气候变化框架公约》通过以来，排放限值的谈判便与界定“危险”气候变化阈值的努力交织在一起。在本章中，我阐述这一集体行动问题框架背后的逻辑；说明这一框架为何未能限制排放以避免“危险”的气候变化；最后，提出一种有望实现更多集体行动的替代框架。

title: Negotiating to Avoid 'Gradual' versus 'Dangerous' Climate Change: An Experimental Test of Two Prisoners' Dilemmas
venue: Towards a New Climate Agreement: Conflict, Resolution, and Governance
abstract: According to the Framework Convention on Climate Change, global collective action is needed to stabilize "greenhouse gas concentrations in the atmosphere at a level that would prevent dangerous [our emphasis] anthropogenic interference with the climate system." The Framework Convention thus implies that, on the far side of some critical concentration level, climate change will be "dangerous," while on the near side of the threshold, climate change will be "safe" (though perhaps still undesirable). Rather than be linear and smooth, the Framework Convention warns that climate change may be "abrupt and catastrophic."
abstract_zh: 根据《联合国气候变化框架公约》，需要全球集体行动，以将“大气中温室气体浓度稳定在能够防止对气候系统产生危险[着重号为我们所加]的人为干扰的水平”。因此，该框架公约隐含地认为，在某一临界浓度水平之外，气候变化将是“危险的”；而在该阈值之内，气候变化则是“安全的”（尽管或许仍不可取）。框架公约警告说，气候变化可能不是线性且平缓的，而可能是“突发且具有灾难性的”。

title: Partha Dasgupta's Contributions to Environment and Development Economics
venue: S. Barrett, K.-G. Mler and E.S. Maskin
abstract: This chapter provides an introduction to the contributions by Partha Dasgupta in the field of environment and development economics, particularly the poverty-population-environment nexus. Building upon Malthus and Smith, Dasgupta has recast the population problem, restored the importance of wealth in economic analysis while also redefining it, and inquired not into why successful countries have prospered by why poor countries have remained poor. His greatest interest has been with the poorest of the poor and the pathways by which they can escape their misery. Specific topics addressed include malnutrition as a poverty trap, optimum human population, fertility decisions, common property management, information problems in pollution control, non-renewable resources and growth, R&D and technical change, the global commons, and the concept of sustainable development. In addition to providing an overview of Dasgupta’s work, the chapter places all the other chapters in this book in the context of Dasgupta’s research agenda, summarizing their contributions.
abstract_zh: 本章介绍帕萨·达斯古普塔（Partha Dasgupta）在环境与发展经济学领域的贡献，尤其是贫困、人口与环境之间的关联。在马尔萨斯和亚当·斯密的基础上，达斯古普塔重新界定了人口问题，恢复了财富在经济分析中的重要地位，同时也重新定义了财富，并且他探究的并非成功国家为何繁荣，而是贫穷国家为何长期贫困。他最关注的是最贫困人群，以及他们摆脱困境的路径。其研究涉及的具体主题包括：作为贫困陷阱的营养不良、最优人口规模、生育决策、公共产权管理、污染控制中的信息问题、不可再生资源与增长、研发与技术变革、全球公共物品，以及可持续发展的概念。除概述达斯古普塔的研究工作外，本章还将本书其他各章置于达斯古普塔的研究议程之中，并总结它们的贡献。

title: Sensitivity of Collective Action to Uncertainty about Climate Tipping Points
Solar Geoengineering's Brave New World: Thoughts on the Governance of An Unprecedented Technology
venue: Review of Environmental Economics and Policy
abstract: Due to the failure of international efforts to limit atmospheric concentrations of greenhouse gases, consideration is now being given to solar geoengineering—a deliberate intervention to limit global warming without altering the atmospheric concentration of greenhouse gases. In contrast to emission cuts, geoengineering is expected to be cheap, quick to lower temperature, and feasible through the use of a single intervention. However, geoengineering is an imperfect substitute for emission reductions and will likely have undesirable side effects, only some of which can be anticipated before geoengineering is deployed. Most importantly, because geoengineering can be undertaken unilaterally, it creates issues of governance: Who gets to decide if, when, and how geoengineering should be attempted? This article provides an introduction to the key issues surrounding the governance of this unprecedented technology. (JEL: Q54, F53, K33)
abstract_zh: 由于国际社会限制大气温室气体浓度的努力未能奏效，人们开始考虑太阳辐射管理（solar geoengineering）——即在不改变大气温室气体浓度的前提下，通过人为干预来限制全球变暖。与减排相比，地球工程预计成本低廉、降温迅速，并且只需实施单一干预即可实现。然而，地球工程只是减排的不完美替代品，很可能产生不良副作用，其中只有部分可以在部署之前预见。最重要的是，由于地球工程可以单边实施，它引发了治理问题：谁有权决定是否、何时以及如何进行地球工程尝试？本文介绍围绕这一前所未有的技术治理的核心议题。（JEL：Q54，F53，K33）

title: Social Norms and Global Environmental Challenges: The Complex Interaction of Behaviors, Values, and Policy
abstract: Government policies are needed when people's behaviors fail to deliver the public good. Those policies will be most effective if they can stimulate long-term changes in beliefs and norms, creating and reinforcing the behaviors needed to solidify and extend the public good. It is often the short-term acceptability of potential policies, rather than their longer-term efficacy, that determines their scope and deployment. The policy process should consider both time scales. The academy, however, has provided insufficient insight on the coevolution of social norms and different policy instruments, thus compromising the capacity of decision makers to craft effective solutions to the society's most intractable environmental problems. Life scientists could make fundamental contributions to this agenda through targeted research on the emergence of social norms.
abstract_zh: 当人们的行为未能提供公共物品时，就需要政府政策。如果这些政策能够激发信念与规范的长期变化，从而创造并强化巩固和扩大公共物品所需的行为，它们将最为有效。然而，决定政策范围与实施的，往往是潜在政策的短期可接受性，而非其长期效力。政策过程应同时考虑这两个时间尺度。然而，学界对社会规范与不同政策工具之间的共同演化关系的洞察仍然不足，从而削弱了决策者设计有效方案以应对社会最顽固环境问题的能力。生命科学家可以通过有针对性地研究社会规范的形成，为这一议题作出根本性贡献。

title: Climate Negotiations Under Scientific Uncertainty
venue: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences
abstract: How does uncertainty about “dangerous” climate change affect the prospects for international cooperation? Climate negotiations usually are depicted as a prisoners’ dilemma game; collectively, countries are better off reducing their emissions, but self-interest impels them to keep on emitting. We provide experimental evidence, grounded in an analytical framework, showing that the fear of crossing a dangerous threshold can turn climate negotiations into a coordination game, making collective action to avoid a dangerous threshold virtually assured. These results are robust to uncertainty about the impact of crossing a threshold, but uncertainty about the location of the threshold turns the game back into a prisoners’ dilemma, causing cooperation to collapse. Our research explains the paradox of why countries would agree to a collective goal, aimed at reducing the risk of catastrophe, but act as if they were blind to this risk.
abstract_zh: 关于“危险”气候变化的不确定性如何影响国际合作前景？气候谈判通常被描绘为囚徒困境博弈：从集体来看，各国通过减排会更好，但自身利益促使它们继续排放。我们依据一个分析框架提供了实验证据，表明对跨越危险阈值的恐惧能够将气候谈判转变为协调博弈，从而几乎确保为避免危险阈值而采取的集体行动。这些结果对跨越阈值的影响的不确定性具有稳健性，但阈值位置的不确定性则会使博弈重新变为囚徒困境，导致合作瓦解。我们的研究解释了一个悖论：各国为何会同意一个旨在降低灾难风险的集体目标，却仿佛对这一风险视而不见。

title: Climate Treaties and Backstop Technologies
abstract: In this paper I examine the design of climate treaties when there exist two kinds of technology, a conventional abatement technology with (linearly) increasing marginal costs and a backstop technology (“air capture”) with high but constant marginal costs. I focus on situations in which countries can gain collectively by using both technologies. I show that, under some circumstances, countries will be better off negotiating treaties that are not cost-effective. When countries prefer to negotiate self-enforcing agreements that are cost-effective, the availability of the backstop technology causes cooperation in abatement to increase significantly.
abstract_zh: 在本文中，我考察了这样一种情形下气候条约的设计：存在两种技术，一种是边际成本（线性）递增的常规减排技术，另一种是边际成本高但恒定的兜底技术（“空气捕集”）。我关注的是各国通过同时使用两种技术可以集体获益的情形。我表明，在某些情况下，各国若谈判签订并非成本有效的条约，境况反而更好。当各国更倾向于谈判签订具有自我执行力且成本有效的协议时，兜底技术的可得性会显著提高减排合作的水平。

title: Rethinking Climate Change Governance and Its Relationship to the World Trading System
abstract: International climate negotiations have thus far eschewed efforts to incorporate trade restrictions, but they have also failed to achieve their objective of reducing global emissions. Because of this failure, some countries are now inclined to act unilaterally and minilaterally, in many cases by imposing trade restrictions against third parties. Such actions are likely to invite retaliation. They could even ignite an escalating trade war. The best way to avoid such conflicts is not to limit the use of trade restrictions, but to make international climate negotiations effective. Ironically, success in addressing climate change multilaterally may require incorporating trade restrictions in a new kind of climate agreement. Trade restrictions have been used successfully in other international agreements. But in these agreements, the primary purpose of the restrictions has been to encourage participation. That is, their primary purpose has been to enforce the agreement. This is the role trade restrictions ought to play in a new climate treaty. But for them to play this role, the design of climate treaties must change. If climate treaties are designed strategically, the threat to restrict trade will suffice to enforce the agreement; and if the threat to restrict trade is credible, and the punishment associated with the restriction severe, trade restrictions will not actually have to be used. By incorporating trade restrictions in this way, greenhouse gas emissions can be reduced without putting at risk the gains from multilateral cooperation in trade.
abstract_zh: 国际气候谈判迄今一直回避纳入贸易限制措施，但它们也未能实现减少全球排放的目标。由于这一失败，一些国家现倾向于单边行动和小范围多边行动，在许多情况下是对第三方实施贸易限制。此类行动很可能招致报复，甚至可能引发不断升级的贸易战。避免此类冲突的最佳办法不是限制贸易限制措施的使用，而是使国际气候谈判真正有效。具有讽刺意味的是，要在多边层面成功应对气候变化，可能需要在一种新型气候协定中纳入贸易限制。贸易限制在其他国际协定中已被成功使用，但在这些协定中，限制措施的主要目的是鼓励参与，即其主要目的在于执行协定。这正是贸易限制在一项新的气候条约中应当发挥的作用。然而，要使其发挥这一作用，气候条约的设计必须改变。如果气候条约经过战略性设计，限制贸易的威胁便足以保障协定的执行；而且，如果这一限制贸易的威胁是可信的，且相关惩罚足够严厉，那么实际上就无需动用贸易限制。通过以这种方式纳入贸易限制，温室气体排放可以得到减少，同时又不会危及多边贸易合作所带来的收益。

title: A Portfolio System of Climate Treaties
venue: Post-Kyoto International Climate Policy: Implementing Architectures for Agreement. Cambridge: Cambridge University Press
abstract: Introduction Climate change is so fundamental a challenge that it may be best addressed from a multiple of perspectives, using a multiple of approaches. This is a radically different concept from the arrangement developed thus far. Under the Kyoto Protocol, emission reduction obligations apply to entire economies, not to individual sectors; reforestation (which sequesters and therefore removes carbon dioxide or CO 2 from the atmosphere) is allowed to substitute for abatement (which reduces greenhouse gas [GHG] additions to the atmosphere, relative to “business as usual”); the emissions of different countries can be traded; and increases in the emission of one gas can be offset by reductions in the emission of another. This approach has one great virtue: it promotes cost-effective abatement. Unfortunately, this approach has also (so far, at least) failed to address the more important objective, which is to reduce GHG emissions and ultimately to stabilize atmospheric concentrations. There may be different explanations for this. My diagnosis is that this failure is due to a lack of robust enforcement. So, why not add an enforcement capability? As I shall explain in this chapter, it may not be possible to enforce the current treaty design. If enforcement is important—and I shall argue here that it is essential—then a better strategy may be to break up the problem, treating different sources and types of gases separately. This strategy may succeed better at reducing emissions overall.
abstract_zh: 引言 气候变化是如此根本性的挑战，或许最好从多种视角、运用多种方法加以应对。这与迄今已形成的安排截然不同。根据《京都议定书》，减排义务适用于整个经济体，而非单个部门；造林（可以吸收并从而移除大气中的二氧化碳或CO2）可以替代减排（即相对于“照常情景”减少温室气体［GHG］向大气的排放）；不同国家的排放可以进行交易；一种气体排放的增加可以通过另一种气体排放的减少来抵消。这种做法有一个巨大的优点：它促进了成本有效的减排。遗憾的是，这种做法（至少迄今为止）也未能实现更重要的目标，即减少温室气体排放并最终稳定大气中的浓度。对此可能有不同的解释。我的诊断是，这一失败源于缺乏有力的执行机制。那么，为何不增加执行能力呢？正如我在本章中将要说明的，现行条约设计可能无法得到有效执行。如果执行至关重要（而我在此将论证其绝对必要），那么一个更好的策略可能是分解问题，对不同的排放源和气体类型分别处理。这一策略可能更有效地实现总体减排。

title: Contrasting Future Paths for an Evolving Climate Regime
abstract:
This article explores two different conceptions of how an emerging policy regime might evolve to strengthen incentives for more vigorous cooperation in mitigating global climate change. One is the paradigm that has figured most prominently in negotiations to this point: the establishment of targets and timetables for countries to limit their aggregate greenhouse gas emissions. The other approach consists of a variety of loosely coordinated smaller‐scale agreements, each one of which addresses a different aspect of the challenge, and is enforced in its own way. Our primary conclusion is that an agreement of the first type may be more cost‐effective, but that a system of agreements of the second type would likely sustain more abatement overall.
To address successfully the colossal collective action problem of climate change, international agreements must achieve a high level of participation; sustain a high level of compliance; and accomplish substantial emissions reductions.
Negotiation of targets and timetables may have advantages for cost‐effectiveness, but poses great difficulties for maintenance and enforcement.
Smaller‐scale agreements that control individual gases or the emissions of individual sectors separately create more options for enforcement.
A combined approach is possible, with targets and timetables being expressed as goals and with specific agreements being negotiated to meet those goals.
abstract_zh:
本文探讨了两种不同的构想，即一个新兴的政策体制可能如何演进，以增强更积极地减缓全球气候变化的激励。第一种是迄今在谈判中最为突出的范式：确立各国限制温室气体总排放量的目标与时间表。另一种思路则由一系列松散协调的小规模协定构成，每项协定针对挑战的不同方面，并以各自的方式加以执行。我们的主要结论是，第一类协定在成本有效性上可能更具优势，但第二类协定体系则可能更能维持总体减排水平。
要成功应对气候变化这一巨大的集体行动问题，国际协定必须实现高水平的参与，维持高水平的遵约，并实现可观的减排。
谈判确定目标与时间表在成本有效性方面可能具有优势，但在维持与执行方面存在巨大困难。
分别控制单一气体或单一部门排放的小规模协定，为执行创造了更多选择。
一种综合方法是可行的：将目标与时间表表述为指导性目标，并就具体协定进行谈判以实现这些目标。

abstract:
This paper explains why the approach taken so far to mitigate global climate change has failed. The central reason is an inability to enforce targets and timetables. Current proposals recommending even stricter emission limits will not help unless they are able to address the enforcement deficit. Trade restrictions are one means for doing so, but trade restrictions pose new problems, particularly if they are applied to enforce economy-wide emission limitation agreements. This paper sketches a different approach that unpacks the climate problem, addressing different gases and sectors using different instruments. It also explains how a failure to address the climate problem fundamentally will only create incentives for different kinds of responses, posing different challenges for climate change governance.

title: The Coming Global Climate-Technology Revolution
Climate Treaties and the Imperative of Enforcement
abstract: This chapter examines issues about the enforcement of treaties on climate change and how weak compliance with the new deal may further increase costs. The policy costs cannot be divorced from the political process, and it is evident that the economics of climate-change policy cannot be considered independently of the politics. The chapter first considers the Kyoto Protocol and its idea of making obligations contingent as well as its limits on greenhouse gas emissions. It then turns to the Montreal Protocol and why it has succeeded where the Kyoto Protocol has failed, along with the lessons that can be learned from Montreal. It also outlines the ‘roadmap’ proposed by the parties to the Framework Convention in Bali in December 2007, with particular emphasis on its ‘enhanced mitigation’ and the need for countries to adapt with respect to climate change. Finally, the chapter explains the importance of financing for mitigation and how technology R&D and diffusion can reduce greenhouse gas emissions significantly.
abstract_zh: 本章考察气候变化条约的执行问题，以及弱遵约如何可能进一步推高成本。政策成本不能脱离政治过程而单独考虑，显然，气候变化政策的经济学也不能独立于政治学来考察。本章首先考察《京都议定书》及其或有义务的理念以及对温室气体排放的限制。随后转向《蒙特利尔议定书》，探讨其为何能成功而《京都议定书》却失败，以及可从蒙特利尔经验中汲取的教训。本章还概述了缔约方于2007年12月在巴厘岛提出的“路线图”，特别强调其中的“强化减缓”以及各国就气候变化进行适应的必要性。最后，本章阐明了为减缓排放提供融资的重要性，以及技术研发与推广如何能够显著减少温室气体排放。

title: An Economic Theory of International Environmental Law
venue: Oxford Handbook of International Environmental Law
abstract: International law, of which international environmental law is a part, shapes and constrains state behaviour. Essentially, it tells states what they are permitted to do, what they are prohibited from doing, and what they are required to do. In this respect, international law is indistinguishable from domestic law. In other respects, however, domestic and international law could not be more different. Domestic law develops and is applied within a vertical system of governance, with a legislature that creates law, a judiciary that interprets law, and an executive that enforces law. International law, by contrast, is rooted to a horizontal system – states at once make, interpret, and enforce international law. This article presents an economic theory of international environmental law, showing how international law can restructure incentives, making it in the interest of states to change their behaviour, and so protect the environment. It examines customary law, theory of treaty design, treaty participation, minimum participation, compliance, narrow and deep versus broad and shallow treaties, tipping treaties, trade restrictions, asymmetric countries, and payment compensation.
abstract_zh: 国际法（国际环境法是其中一部分）塑造并约束国家行为。从根本上说，它告诉各国被允许做什么、被禁止做什么以及被要求做什么。在这方面，国际法与国内法并无二致。然而，在其他方面，国内法与国际法又截然不同。国内法是在纵向治理体系中形成并适用的：立法机关制定法律，司法机关解释法律，行政机关执行法律。相比之下，国际法植根于横向体系——各国同时制定、解释并执行国际法。本文提出一种国际环境法的经济学理论，说明国际法如何重构激励，使改变行为符合各国利益，从而保护环境。本文考察了习惯法、条约设计理论、条约参与、最低参与门槛、遵约、窄而深与宽而浅的条约、临界点条约、贸易限制、不对称国家以及补偿支付等问题。

title: Climate Change Negotiations: Past and Future
abstract: In the history of large-scale, international negotiations, no issue has attracted as much attention as global climate change (the previous record holder was the Law of the Sea negotiations). For over 15 years, numerous negotiating sessions have been held, involving huge delegations, supported in turn by countless domestic meetings among specialized agencies and ministries, colossal efforts by the Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change to synthesize the scientific evidence, and the further attentions of environmental groups, businesses, and academics. The input into this process has been unprecedented.
abstract_zh: 在大规模国际谈判的历史上，没有哪一议题像全球气候变化那样吸引了如此多的关注（此前的纪录保持者是《海洋法公约》谈判）。十五年来，众多谈判会议相继召开，有大量代表团与会，同时各专业机构和部门举行了无数次国内会议，政府间气候变化专门委员会也付出了巨大努力以综合科学证据，环保团体、企业和学者也进一步加以关注。这一进程所获得的投入是前所未有的。

title: Emerging Infectious Diseases: Are We Prepared?

abstract: An effective climate change treaty must promote the joint supply of two global public goods: climate change mitigation and knowledge of new technologies that can lower mitigation costs. R&D is especially needed to bring about substantial, long-term reductions in atmospheric concentrations of greenhouse gases, for this will require the development and diffusion of revolutionary, “breakthrough ” technologies (Martin I. Hoffert et al. 2002). In principle, such an outcome could be realized by the Kyoto Protocol approach, if that agreement were strengthened over time. However, that response may be inadequate (Kyoto makes no provision for R&D)—and, as I shall demonstrate, unlikely to succeed in any event. Can a treaty system relying directly on targeted R&D and the adoption of breakthrough technologies perform better in this same setting of anarchic international relations? I shall show that, as a general rule, the answer is no. Essentially, the same forces that undermine Kyoto also challenge the R&D and technology approach. There is one exception to this rule: R&D leading to breakthrough technologies exhibiting increasing returns can improve dramatically on the Kyoto approach, even when these technologies are otherwise inferior to the alternatives available. This suggests that our approach to treaty design should be strategic. 2I. The Kyoto Approach Begin by considering the abatement decisions of countries in the absence of a multilateral agreement. Hoffert et al. 2002）。原则上，若《京都议定书》机制随时间得到强化，这一结果是可以实现的。然而，该应对方式可能是不充分的（《京都议定书》对研发未作任何规定），而且，正如我将证明的，无论如何都不太可能成功。在无政府主义的国际关系背景下，依赖于直接针对研发和采用突破性技术的条约体系能否表现得更好？我将表明，总体而言，答案是否定的。从本质上讲，那些削弱《京都议定书》的力量同样对研发与技术路径构成挑战。这一一般规则有一个例外：导致收益递增的突破性技术研发，即使这些技术在其他方面劣于可用的替代方案，仍可以大幅改进《京都议定书》的路径。这表明我们的条约设计方法应当具有战略性。2I. 京都路径 首先考察在没有多边协定的情况下各国的减排决策。令qi表示国家i的减排量，Q表示总减排量；若有N个国家，则Q = Σqi（i=1至N）。最后，令国家i的收益为 pi = bQ − c qi。

title: Increasing Participation and Compliance in International Climate Change Agreements
venue: International Environmental Agreements: Politics, Law, and Economics
abstract: Scientific and economic consensus increasingly points to the need for a credible and cost-effective approach to address the threat of global climate change, but the Kyoto Protocol to the U.N. Framework Convention on Climate Change appears incapable of inducing significant participation and compliance. We assess the Protocol and thirteen alternative policy architectures that have been proposed, with particular attention to their respective abilities to induce participation and compliance. We find that those approaches that offer cost-effective mitigation are unlikely to induce significant participation and compliance, while those approaches that are likely to enjoy a reasonably high level of implementation by sovereign states are sorely lacking in terms of their anticipated cost effectiveness. The feasible set of policy architectures is thus limited to second-best alternatives. Much more attention needs to be given - both by scholarly research and by international negotiations - to aspects of future international climate agreements that will affect the degrees of participation and compliance that can reasonably be expected to be forthcoming.
abstract_zh: 科学与经济界日益形成共识，认为需要一种可信且具有成本效益的途径来应对全球气候变化的威胁，但《联合国气候变化框架公约》的《京都议定书》似乎无法有效促使各方广泛参与和遵约。我们评估了《京都议定书》以及已提出的十三种替代性政策架构，尤其关注它们分别促进参与和遵约的能力。我们发现，那些能够提供成本有效减排的方案，不太可能促使各方广泛参与和遵约；而那些可能得到主权国家较高程度执行的方案，在预期成本效益方面又严重不足。因此，可行的政策架构选择仅限于次优方案。无论是学术研究还是国际谈判，都需要更多关注未来国际气候协议中那些将影响参与和遵约程度的方面，这些程度才是可以合理期待的。

title: Thirteen Plus One: A Comparison of Global Climate Policy Architectures
abstract:
We critically review the Kyoto Protocol and thirteen alternative policy architectures for addressing the threat of global climate change. We employ six criteria to evaluate the policy proposals: environmental outcome, dynamic efficiency, cost effectiveness, equity, flexibility in the presence of new information, and incentives for participation and compliance. The Kyoto Protocol does not fare well on a number of criteria, but none of the alternative proposals fare well along all six dimensions. We identify several major themes among the alternative proposals: Kyoto is "too little, too fast"; developing countries should play a more substantial role and receive incentives to participate; implementation should focus on market-based approaches, especially those with price mechanisms; and participation and compliance incentives are inadequately addressed by most proposals. Our investigation reveals tensions among several of the evaluative criteria, such as between environmental outcome and efficiency, and between
cost-effectiveness and incentives for participation and compliance.
abstract_zh: 我们批判性地回顾了《京都议定书》以及用于应对全球气候变化威胁的十三种替代性政策架构。我们采用六项标准评估这些政策方案：环境结果、动态效率、成本效益、公平、面对新信息时的灵活性，以及参与和遵约的激励。《京都议定书》在多项标准上表现不佳，但没有任何替代方案在全部六个维度上都表现良好。我们识别出替代方案中的几个主要主题：《京都议定书》“力度太小、速度太快”；发展中国家应发挥更为实质性的作用，并获得参与的激励；执行应侧重于市场化方法，尤其是那些具有价格机制的方法；而大多数方案对参与和遵约激励的处理都不充分。我们的考察揭示出若干评价标准之间存在张力，例如环境结果与效率之间，以及成本效益与参与和遵约激励之间。

title: Towards a Better Climate Treaty
abstract:
The essential problem with the Kyoto approach is that it provides poor incentives for participation and compliance. The minimum participation clause is set at such a low level that the agreement can enter into force while limiting the emissions of less than a third of the global total. The compliance mechanism, negotiated years after the emission limits were agreed upon, essentially requires that non-complying countries punish themselves for failing to comply - a provision that is unlikely to influence behavior. The likely outcome will be an agreement that fails to enter into force, or an agreement that enters into force but is not implemented, or an agreement that enters into force and is implemented but only because it requires that countries do next to nothing about limiting their emissions. These weaknesses cannot be improved by a minor redesign of the treaty. The basic problem stems from the requirement that countries agree to, and meet, emission limitation ceilings; the most central element of the Kyoto Protocol.
My proposal focuses on collective funding of basic research into the development of new, carbon-saving energy technologies, and on standards protocols for the adoption and diffusion of new technologies around the world. The main attraction of this approach is strategic: it does not require that compliance be enforced, and it provides positive incentives for participation. It is not an ideal remedy to global climate change, but the principle of sovereignty means that an ideal remedy does not exist for this problem.
abstract_zh:
《京都》路径的根本问题在于，它为参与和遵约提供的激励不足。最低参与条款设定得如此之低，以至于协定在仅限制全球不到三分之一排放的情况下即可生效。遵约机制是在排放限值商定多年之后才谈判达成的，其实质是要求不遵约的国家自我惩罚——这一规定不太可能影响行为。可能的结果是：协定无法生效；或者协定虽然生效，但未被执行；或者协定生效并得到执行，但仅仅因为它几乎不要求各国在限制排放方面做任何事情。这些弱点无法通过对条约进行小幅修改来改善。根本问题源于要求各国同意并履行排放限制上限——这正是《京都议定书》最核心的要素。
我的建议侧重于为研发新型节能减碳技术的基础研究提供集体资金，并制定在全世界采用和推广新技术的标准协议。这一方法的主要吸引力是战略性的：它无需强制执行遵约，并能为参与提供正向激励。这并非应对全球气候变化的理想方案，但主权原则意味着，对于这一问题并不存在理想的解决办法。

title: International Cooperation for Sale
Freedom, Growth, and the Environment
abstract: A number of recent papers have found that certain measures of pollution worsen and later improve as income per head increases. It is widely believed that the downhill portion of this inverted-U curve reflects an induced policy response; that, as incomes rise, citizens demand improvements in environmental quality, and that these demands are delivered by the political system. In this paper we find that, for a number of pollution variables, an increase in civil and political freedoms significantly improves environmental quality. For other pollution variables, however, we find that freedoms have no effect. The former finding suggests that political reforms may be as important as economic reforms in improving environmental quality worldwide. The latter finding hints that the observation that pollution levels fall with income, once income becomes high enough, may not always reflect an induced policy response.
abstract_zh: 近期有许多论文发现，某些污染指标会随人均收入增加先恶化、后改善。人们普遍认为，这一倒U形曲线的下降部分反映了诱导性的政策反应：随着收入上升，公民要求改善环境质量，而这些诉求由政治体制加以回应。本文发现，对于若干污染变量，公民和政治自由的增加能显著改善环境质量；而对于其他污染变量，自由则没有影响。前一发现表明，在改善全球环境质量方面，政治改革可能与经济改革同样重要。后一发现则暗示，当收入达到足够高的水平后，污染水平随收入下降的现象，未必总是反映了诱导性的政策反应。

abstract: This paper analyzes the links between policies aimed at supplying a global public good and international trade in segmented markets. I find that the credible threat to impose trade sanctions may be capable of sustaining full cooperation in the supply of the public good, provided the sanctions are accompanied by a minimum participation clause which serves to coordinate government behavior. In equilibrium, trade is not restricted. But if the threat to impose sanctions were not allowed by the rules of the game, supply of the public good would be Pareto-inefficient. © 1997 Elsevier Science B.V.
abstract_zh: 本文分析了旨在提供全球公共物品的政策与分割市场中的国际贸易之间的联系。我发现，可信的贸易制裁威胁有可能维持公共物品供给的完全合作，前提是这些制裁辅以一项最低参与条款，以协调政府行为。在均衡状态下，贸易并不受到限制。但如果博弈规则不允许实施制裁威胁，公共物品的供给将是帕累托无效率的。© 1997 Elsevier Science B.V.

title: Self-Enforcing International Environmental Agreements
Strategic Environmental Policy and International Trade
abstract: This paper demonstrates that governments may have incentives to impose weak environmental standards on industries that compete for business in imperfectly competitive international markets, where ‘weak’ means that the marginal cost of abatement is less than the marginal damage from pollution. However, such an intervention is not as efficient as an export or R&D subsidy in improving competitiveness, and depending on the form of competition and market structure, it may instead be optimal for governments to impose strong environmental standards, where ‘strong’ means that the marginal cost of abatement exceeds the marginal environmental damage. The existence of less strict environmental standards in a lower income country … is not a sufficient basis for claiming that the environmental standards are ‘too low’ or that the country is manipulating its environmental standards in order to improve the competitiveness of its producers. To substantiate such a claim, it would be necessary at the very least to demonstrate that the standards are even lower than would be expected on the basis of such factors as the level of per capita income and the characteristics of the physical environment. Clearly, that would be very difficult to do. Moreover, the charge might also be aimed at highly developed countries in which stringent environmental standards may have been adopted in some areas but where, because of competitiveness considerations, governments have shied away from high standards in others. [ GATT (1992 , p. 29)].
abstract_zh: 本文表明，政府可能有动机对在不完全竞争的国际市场中争夺业务的行业实施较弱的环境标准，这里“较弱”指减排的边际成本低于污染的边际损害。然而，这种干预在提高竞争力方面并不如出口补贴或研发补贴有效，而且，根据竞争形式与市场结构的不同，政府反而可能最优地选择实施较强的环境标准，这里“较强”指减排的边际成本超过环境的边际损害。在收入较低的国家存在较宽松的环境标准……这一事实本身并不足以断言环境标准“过低”，或该国正在操纵环境标准以提高其生产者的竞争力。要证实这一主张，至少需要证明这些标准甚至低于基于人均收入水平和自然环境特征等因素所预期的水平。显然，这将非常困难。此外，这一指责也可能针对高度发达国家，因为这些国家在某些领域可能采取了严格的环境标准，但出于竞争力考虑，政府在另一些领域则回避了高标准。［GATT（1992，第29页）］。

abstract: The public's increasing demand for environmental protection will inevitably increase the demands for environmental regulation. But this need not be bad news for industry. Companies will often find that their interests coincide with those of the regulators, and astute players will try to shape the regulation accordingly.
abstract_zh: 公众对环境保护日益增长的需求，必然会增加对环境监管的诉求。但这未必对产业界是坏消息。企业往往会发现其利益与监管者的利益是一致的，而精明的参与者会设法据此塑造监管。

title: Optimal Soil Conservation and the Reform of Agricultural Pricing Policies
The Problem of Global Environmental Protection
abstract: Suppose that land is communally owned. Every person has the right to hunt, till, or mine the land. This form of ownership fails to concentrate the cost associated with any person's exercise of his communal right on that person. If a person seeks to maximize the value of his communal rights, he will tend to overhunt and overwork the land because some of the costs of his doing so are borne by others. The stock of game and the richness of the soil will be diminished too quickly. It is conceivable that those who own these rights, i.e. every member of the community, can agree to curtail the rate at which they work the lands if negotiating and policing costs are zero… [However,] negotiating costs will be large because it is difficult for many persons to reach a mutually satisfactory agreement, especially when each hold-out has the right to work the land as fast as he pleases. [Furthermore,] even if an agreement among all can be reached, we must yet take account of the costs of policing the agreement, and these may be large, also.
abstract_zh: 假设土地为共有。每个人都有权狩猎、耕种或开采这片土地。这种所有权形式无法使个人行使其共有权利的成本集中于其本人身上。若某人试图使其共有权利的价值最大化，他就倾向于过度狩猎和过度开垦土地，因为其行为的部分成本由他人承担。野生动物的存量和土壤的肥力将被过快地耗竭。如果谈判和监督成本为零，那么拥有这些权利的人——即社区中的每一个成员——或许可以同意限制其开发土地的速度……［然而］谈判成本将十分高昂，因为要让众多人达成彼此满意的协议很困难，尤其是当每个不愿合作的人都有权按自己的意愿尽快开发土地时。［此外］即使所有人之间能够达成协议，我们仍须考虑监督协议执行的成本，而这些成本同样可能很高。
